runs on its route-bound controller"] Capture --> Guard["ScopeGuard: every required policy column present
(Strict refuses, Repair adds a missing one)"] Guard --> Harvest["Minimal projection, SQL text harvested,
parameters renamed alias_name"] Harvest --> Compose["Composed by alias only:
EXISTS, NOT EXISTS, LEFT JOIN, derived table"] ","style":"notebook"}
